_comment: Copy this file to config/local.json on each machine and edit it for that machine's current connection type, channel mapping, and device IDs. In the 7-byte Bolt reports below, byte 2 (for example 0x01 or 0x02 in 0x10,0x01,...) is the receiver-side device address, while byte 5 (0x00, 0x01, 0x02) is the Easy-Switch channel.

channel-1.description: Fill this with the device reports for whichever computer is paired on Easy-Switch channel 1 for this clone. If switching fails, verify both the selector and the report's device address byte; it may not match another machine or the numbering shown in Options+.

channel-2.description: These Windows-side Bolt commands were verified for channel 2 on your current setup. The second report byte selects which paired device on the receiver to command, and the fifth report byte selects the target Easy-Switch channel.

channel-3.description: These channel 3 payloads are the channel 2 payloads with only the channel byte changed from 0x01 to 0x02. Do not assume the second byte stays correct on a different receiver; verify the device address on your hardware before relying on them.
